items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen (wall-fixed near the hob, surge damaged)
items.rationale: Policy covers overvoltage from lightning (2.3.3) for fixed installations; kitchen climate endorsement overrides 2.3.10(c) exclusion for units near the hob. Like-for-like replacement is indemnified up to ordinary market price (7.1.9, 7.1.10). Reference cases 38 and 42 set t per pc at 1340–1536; price prior mean 1413.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - hallway (wall-fixed, surge damaged)
items.rationale: Same as line 1: fixed installation, surge damage, like-for-like replacement, covered peril (2.3.3), no exclusion applies. Reference cases 38 and 42 set t per pc at 1340–1536; price prior mean 1413.

items.description: Split unit - study (ships with handheld wireless remote, movable)
items.rationale: Movable, not firmly connected (1.3, 4.2.3, 4.3(d)), so not insured property. Excluded regardless of surge damage. Reference cases: such units always t = 0.
Labour to install a covered replacement (line 1) is indemnified (7.1.9(c)), up to ordinary market price. Reference cases 38, 42: t per pc 468–505; price prior mean 479.
Labour to install a covered replacement (line 2) is indemnified (7.1.9(c)), up to ordinary market price. Reference cases 38, 42: t per pc 468–505; price prior mean 479.
Principal item (line 3) is excluded (not insured property), so ancillary charge for its installation is also excluded (7.1.11). Reference cases: t = 0 for installation of non-fixed units.

items.description: Standard freight - replacement equipment pallet (over 80 kg)
items.rationale: Ordinary carriage of covered replacement items (lines 1 and 2) is indemnified (7.1.9(e), 7.1.12). Reference cases 42, 38: t per shipment 42–51; moderate estimate for heavy pallet.
Express/priority surcharges are excluded (7.1.12), unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert further loss, which is not stated here.
Return visit charges are excluded (7.1.13); only one attendance per undertaking per event is indemnified. Reference cases: t = 0 in all 7 earlier cases.
General admin/processing fees are excluded (7.1.8(b)). Reference cases: t = 0 in all 12 earlier cases.
Disposal of property not damaged by the insured event and not replaced by a covered item is excluded (5.2.1, 3.5(a), 7.1.7(a)).
